messages.author: 28c4414178f1336a
messages.subject: Shinyapps.io and Tensorflow
parts:
Hello

Considering the default system packages for shiny apps include Python (various versions), has anyone been able to successfully run a Tensorflow or Keras app on shinyapps.io? The models will be trained prior to upload, and fit well within the required memory/disk sizes. 

Thanks,

Phil

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shinyapps.io and Tensorflow
parts:
We have tested that it works if you include the trained model as part of the application.

See https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps-package-dependencies/blob/master/packages/tensorflow/install for details on what is installed at this time.
